name: Boston criteria v2.0
context: Etiologic classification of sporadic CAA in defined age/presentation contexts
technical_validity: Depends on high-quality hemorrhagic and nonhemorrhagic MRI marker rating
biological_validity: Markers are associated with CAA but are not individually pathognomonic
diagnostic_accuracy: Strongest in symptomatic tissue-selected cohorts; lower in community and nonhemorrhagic validations
prognostic_validity: Criteria category is not itself a complete outcome-risk model
incremental_value: Adds nonhemorrhagic markers over earlier versions; context-dependent
transportability: Limited outside populations resembling validation cohorts
clinical_utility: Useful diagnostic framework when applied within intended context
main_failure_mode: Spectrum effects, mixed pathology, inadequate MRI, and using criteria as universal screening
next_validation: Prospective presentation-specific external validation with full reference standard

name: ARTS
context: Research prediction of pathology-linked arteriolosclerosis risk
technical_validity: Promising repeatability evidence, including conference-level validation
biological_validity: Development linked MRI/demographic features to autopsy pathology
diagnostic_accuracy: Development AUC reported; independent external pathology accuracy not established
prognostic_validity: Associations with cognition and vascular outcomes reported
incremental_value: Not yet demonstrated against strong conventional baselines across independent cohorts
main_failure_mode: Conflating reproducibility or outcome association with diagnostic validation
next_validation: Locked independent MRI-autopsy validation with calibration and decision analysis

name: CVR MRI
context: Physiological measurement of vascular reserve in SVD/VCID
technical_validity: Multisite protocol evidence exists; acquisition and gas delivery remain demanding
biological_validity: Measures vascular responsiveness and predicts some structural progression
diagnostic_accuracy: No pathology-specific CAA or arteriolosclerosis threshold
prognostic_validity: Associated with cognition and one-year WMH/PVS progression; not all clinical outcomes
incremental_value: Needs comparison with conventional MRI and vascular risks
transportability: Promising across research sites; routine-care feasibility limited
main_failure_mode: Treating a general vascular-function signal as an etiologic diagnosis

name: Regional amyloid PET
context: Research differentiation of CAA, AD, and controls
biological_validity: Detects fibrillar amyloid but vascular/parenchymal compartment assignment is indirect
diagnostic_accuracy: Group-level regional differences; no validated universal patient threshold
incremental_value: Unclear beyond MRI and AD biomarkers
transportability: Limited by tracer, stage, and reference-standard heterogeneity
main_failure_mode: Calling amyloid positivity vascular CAA in an older person with AD
next_validation: Multi-tracer PET-to-autopsy study with mixed-pathology modeling

name: CAA-ri clinicoradiologic criteria
technical_validity: Requires appropriate FLAIR, susceptibility, diffusion, and often contrast imaging
biological_validity: Phenotype reflects inflammatory/permeability injury around amyloid-laden vessels
diagnostic_accuracy: Validated in selected cohorts; mimic-rich external performance remains uncertain
prognostic_validity: Not a complete treatment-response or relapse model
incremental_value: Can reduce unnecessary biopsy when syndrome and imaging align
transportability: Best in specialist contexts with alternative-diagnosis assessment
main_failure_mode: Missing infection, neoplasm, PRES, vasculitis, or therapy-associated ARIA
next_validation: Prospective blinded accuracy study including realistic mimics

name: Total SVD score
technical_validity: Simple and reproducible when component ratings are reliable
biological_validity: Combines downstream injury markers from potentially different etiologies
diagnostic_accuracy: Not intended to diagnose a vessel pathology
prognostic_validity: Associated with clinical and network outcomes in several cohorts
incremental_value: May summarize burden efficiently but can discard spatial and continuous information
transportability: Reasonable for burden comparisons with harmonized definitions
main_failure_mode: Interpreting a burden score as CAA or arteriolosclerosis
next_validation: Outcome-specific comparison with continuous and spatial measures

name: ARIA monitoring framework
technical_validity: Standardized serial MRI and communication are central
biological_validity: ARIA-E and ARIA-H reflect therapy-associated permeability/inflammatory and hemorrhagic injury
diagnostic_accuracy: Designed for treatment context, not spontaneous CAA diagnosis
prognostic_validity: Baseline markers inform risk; severe-event prediction remains limited
incremental_value: Provides operational safety value beyond unsystematic MRI review
clinical_utility: High within current treatment pathways using drug-specific guidance
main_failure_mode: Confusing ARIA with infarct, PRES, spontaneous CAA-ri, or other mimics
next_validation: Large real-world registry with standardized MRI and adjudicated severe outcomes
